Package CPDFGeneration

Class CHtmlHeaderFooterOptions

java.lang.Object
CPDFGeneration.CHtmlHeaderFooterOptions
public class CHtmlHeaderFooterOptions extends Object
Header/footer templates and metadata used during HTML or email PDF conversion. Apply this configuration with CConverterProperties.setHeaderFooterOptions(CHtmlHeaderFooterOptions); the properties copy its values. Templates use the renderer's supported HTML/CSS and do not execute JavaScript.
Since:
1.3.0

  • Constructor Details

    • CHtmlHeaderFooterOptions

      public CHtmlHeaderFooterOptions()
      Create disabled headers/footers with empty template/metadata strings and zero skip counts.

    • CHtmlHeaderFooterOptions

      public CHtmlHeaderFooterOptions(boolean displayHeaderFooter, String headerTemplate, String footerTemplate, String baseUri, String title, String url, String date, int skipLeadingTemplatePages, int skipLeadingNumberedPages)
      Create a header/footer configuration, treating null strings as empty strings. Empty templates select the renderer's defaults when headers/footers are enabled.
      Parameters:
      displayHeaderFooter - whether to render headers and footers
      headerTemplate - header HTML; empty selects the default header
      footerTemplate - footer HTML; empty selects the default footer
      baseUri - template resource base URI; empty uses the body resource directory
      title - title metadata; empty uses the body's HTML title
      url - URL metadata, supplied by the caller when no source URL exists
      date - date metadata; empty uses the conversion's local date/time
      skipLeadingTemplatePages - nonnegative count of initial pages with templates hidden
      skipLeadingNumberedPages - nonnegative count of initial pages excluded from numbering and header/footer rendering
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either skip count is negative
